note: City of Flandreau park on a bend of the Big Sioux River, 1 mi east of the SD-32/SD-13 junction. The 16 concrete pads (12 x 32 ft) are in one row along a lane about 30-45 m from the river over open lawn; boat ramp, picnic shelters, ball fields and the Oxbow Wetlands Nature Trail. Closes for the winter (closed from 2026-10-13); no opening date posted. --Claude
summary: City page + sign photo + Google + imagery: 16 concrete 12x32 pads, electric + water (amps unstated), $20 FCFS prepay, tent $7, 14-day limit, showers/dump. Riverfront KEPT (one row of pads ~32-45 m from the Big Sioux over lawn). Electric amperage and pull-through cleared (review/unsourced). Phone '' -> 605-997-2492 (city office).
flags: WATERFRONT: riverfront KEPT. Big Sioux River ~45-50 m wide (a river, not creekside). All 16 pads are one row on the river side of the park: east pads ~44.0560,-96.5672 ~32 m, middle (stored pin 44.05589,-96.56785) ~37 m, west pads ~44.0555,-96.5687 ~45 m from the south bank over mown grass and a gravel lane with scattered single trees (leaf-off imagery; no continuous canopy; city photo shows open lawn to the water). Pads are not numbered on any source; all are sold nightly FCFS. Weak point: the west-end pads are near the ~50 m bound and summer leaf-out of the bank trees will screen parts of the view.
